episodes.title: Bienvenides todes
episodes.summary: On the first day of school, sparks fly between Jana and Esteban, and a hazing-gone-wrong endangers the freshmen's auditions for The Battle of the Bands.

episodes.title: Audiciones
episodes.summary: Jana takes the blame for the fire and asks Dixon for help in finding the real culprits. The first years showcase their talent during auditions.

episodes.title: Va a caer
episodes.summary: Celina suspects The Lodge is behind the hazing and sets out to uncover the truth. MJ is on a mission to form a band — and win Esteban's attention.

episodes.title: Simulacro
episodes.summary: Luka wreaks havoc in The Nonames to fulfill his secret agenda. Esteban opens up to Dixon about his past. Things get heated between Jana and Esteban.

episodes.title: La primera vez
episodes.summary: At a party at Jana's house, the band plots a scheme to get Sebas to confess he's a member of The Lodge. Andi and Emilia share an intimate moment.

episodes.title: Sálvame
episodes.summary: For the semi-final, the bands create music videos for RBD's most iconic songs. Luka reveals information to Esteban about his mom — on one condition.

episodes.title: Hasta que amanezca
episodes.summary: While investigating Anita, a series of misunderstandings spark a fight among the band members. Meanwhile, Esteban learns a painful truth about himself.

episodes.title: La gran final
episodes.summary: To make it to the final of The Battle of the Bands, The Nonames race around the clock to get solid proof that will expose the members of The Lodge.

episodes.title: Back to School
episodes.summary: The MEP's new director cancels the Battle of the Bands but announces a new competition with a high-stakes prize. Okane, the newcomer, throws a party.

episodes.title: Ser o Parecer
episodes.summary: Gus plans a late-night activity to make the students face their demons. Emilia lands in hot water with Andi. Esteban feels intrigued by intern Ilse.

episodes.title: Let's duet!
episodes.summary: Jana and MJ's rivalry is fueled when the students are paired in duets. Gus enlists Okane for some shady business. Esteban's love life becomes hectic.

episodes.title: Viral
episodes.summary: Dixon has a party in the Under. Jana and Okane's strategy to ramp up their social media gets out of hand. Andi looks for a way to cope with her pain.

episodes.title: El show debe continuar
episodes.summary: After Andi's incident, the EWS undergoes significant changes. Everyone focuses on rehearsing for a musical based on RBD's history. Okane opens up to Luka.

episodes.title: Vuelta al sol
episodes.summary: Luka convinces Esteban to throw his birthday bash at the Coluccis' house. Jana asks Dixon to come with her to the party. Sebas and MJ get into a fight.

episodes.title: Y.O.L.O.
episodes.summary: Dixon asks Gus to let him perform in the final. MJ grapples with her religious morals. When his dad expedites his transfer, Luka tries to blackmail Gus.

episodes.title: Otro día que va
episodes.summary: The students realize that all the misfortunes and tragedies of the school year lead back to one person, so they band together to expose the truth.
